units.source_scale_reason: Reviewed source-resolution registration; one anatomical scale per original image.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed all chronological source frames, enlarged grips/crew/edges and move loop endpoints, then all 167 selected phases in offscreen Godot at native battle scale. Two operators, grounded reciprocal push and wheel rotation, empty-fist melee, mounted recoil, held brace and nonmagical lever/valve support remain readable. Original eight-phase 260ms articulated idle reviewed and retained. Hit and death remain unaccepted due to backdrop/identity and collapse/wheel defects. No continuous playback, manual game playtest or Linux execution claimed.
